narrative.overview:
The diary moved off a dark screen and onto paper. The ground is cream, the ink is the plate's black, and the only colour in the room comes from produce: the red of braised pork, the gold of crisp skin, the green of the cucumber alongside it. It reads like a page torn from a food magazine — a photograph, a rule, a name, a note.

Colour here is material, not decoration. Every accent in this sheet came out of the same photograph, so they already belong together; the discipline is in what each one is allowed to do. Because the accents are vivid and the ground is mid-light, an accent can never carry small text or a hairline — red on paper measures 2.84:1 and yellow 1.25:1. Accents are fills with ink inside them (red 5.3:1, yellow 12.1:1), and anything that must be read is ink on paper (15.2:1). That single constraint shapes the whole interface.

The frame stays quiet so the photography can be loud. Cards are not filled panels; they are separated by a single ink rule, the way a magazine separates a story. Tokens live as CSS custom properties at the top of styles.css: primitives first, then semantic aliases (--surface-page, --surface-raised, --text-primary, --text-secondary, --accent, --accent-deep, --accent-alt, --accent-quiet, --border-subtle). color-scheme: light is declared so native controls follow the world.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper ground (#efe1c7) and ink text (#100b08) — 15.2:1.
Accents as fills only: red (#ff303a) and yellow (#f4c700), always with ink on top.
Outlines and state in ink, never in an accent.
No card shadows, no rounded panels, no gradients except the cover scrim.
Dish identity carried by fill plus shape.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Accent Rule
rules.body: No accent carries text or a line directly on paper. Red and yellow are fills; ink sits inside them. Anything read directly on the page is ink or ink-muted.

rules.name: The No-Fill-Card Rule
rules.body: Entries are separated by an ink rule, not by a panel. Bone is reserved for things that float over the map.

dos: Do keep the ground cream and the reading colour ink.
Do let accents be fills, with ink text inside them.
Do carry dish identity with fill plus shape: red teardrop, yellow diamond.
Do keep every control 44px tall with a visible 2px ink focus ring.
Do hold the 1120px column and the single 600px breakpoint.
donts: Don't set red, yellow, orange, coral or green as small text or as a hairline on paper.
Don't put paper/cream text inside a red or yellow fill.
Don't add a shadow or a rounded corner to a card.
Don't introduce a gradient outside the cover scrim.
Don't fill a card panel; separate entries with a rule.
